title: [reading request] ruling 5770445203 step 1 for #19620: on every rig holding tenant metadata, how many stored `translation` items carry a top-level `settings` key — no fleet channel reaches a rig
body:
Maintainer-action: run the reading below on every rig that holds tenant metadata (cloud production + any staging / self-hosted instance you can reach) and paste the counts as a comment here — done when a comment on this card carries the per-rig counts (a zero is a reading too).

Filing gate: ④ (a coordination node — the one reading a ruled card's first step needs, which no fleet channel can take). Reader: the maintainer (the reading), then `domain:spec` seat 4, which re-dispatches #19620 against it. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

**事情**：您裁了 #19620（批 #210 item 2，字母 B）：翻译「条目门」不再接受 `settings`。裁决第 ① 步写明：**先取生产读数**——可达环境里有没有已存的翻译条目带 `settings`；够不着就立协调卡，⛔ 不在空白上继续。开发在本容器里实测够不着任何环境（所有部署域名经出口代理都回 403，本地没有数据库），所以按裁决停在第 ① 步，没写代码。

**要您做的一件事**：在您能访问的每个环境里跑下面的读数，把数字贴在本卡评论里。读数为 0 ⇒ #19620 按裁决直接做第 ②③ 步；不为 0 ⇒ 那几条要不要迁移，由数据决定 D2 转换是「迁移」还是「拒绝」。

## The reading (as specified by the implementing round, `5789861240` on #19620)

On every rig that holds tenant metadata: count `sys_metadata` rows with `type` in (`translation`, `translations`) whose JSON `metadata` column carries a top-level `settings` or `setting` key — grouped by `state` (active AND draft, not active alone) and by organization / environment, listing the `settings` namespaces present in each hit. Include `sys_metadata_history` if a restore can resurrect a row.

**Why the RAW column, not a schema parse**: `authored-translation-sync.ts` (around `:155`) deep-merges the raw stored payload, so a stored hit keeps overriding platform settings copy at runtime even after the schema narrows — a parse-based count would read zero for exactly the rows that matter.

## What the fleet already measured (so it is not re-asked)

- Channels tried from a cloud seat container (2026-09-23T05:5xZ): env scan — no database / ObjectStack variables; `cloud.objectos.ai`, `api.objectstack.ai`, `studio.objectstack.ai`, `demo.objectstack.ai`, `objectstack.ai` — each `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`; no local ObjectStack server; no `*.db` / `*.sqlite` file.
- Tree reading (⛔ not a production rig): no example or fixture stores a `translation` item with `settings`; the only item-door `settings` uses are the schema tests `translation.test.ts:1295` / `:1337`, which assert the door ACCEPTS it (they flip in step ③).

## Unblocks

#19620 (`pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by:` this card).
